v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Commune aut Festo

text.la: Sancti tui, * Dómine, florébunt sicut lílium, allelúia: et sicut odor bálsami erunt ante te, allelúia.
text.en: Your saints, O Lord, * flourish like lilies, alleluia: and like the smell of balsam are before you, alleluia.

text.la: In cæléstibus regnis * Sanctórum habitátio est, allelúia: et in ætérnum réquies eórum, allelúia.
text.en: In the heavenly kingdom is the habitation of the saints, alleluia: and they rest in the eternity, alleluia.

text.la: In velaménto * clamábant Sancti tui, Dómine, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Protected by a veil * your saints turn to you, O Lord, alleluia, alleluia.

text.la: Spíritus et ánimæ * iustórum hymnum dícite Deo nostro, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Spirits and souls * of the just, sing hymns to our Lord, alleluia, alleluia.

text.la: Fulgébunt iusti * sicut sol in conspéctu Dei, allelúia.
text.en: The just shine * like the sun at the face of God, alleluia.

text.la: Stabunt iusti in magna constántia advérsus eos qui se angustiavérunt et qui abstulérunt labóres eórum.
text.en: Then shall the just stand with great constancy against those that have afflicted them, and taken away their labours.

v.en: Precious in the sight of the Lord, alleluia.

r.en: Is the death of his saints, alleluia.

text.la: Sancti et iusti * in Dómino gaudéte, allelúia: vos elégit Deus in hereditátem sibi, allelúia.
text.en: Saints and just * rejoice in the Lord, alleluia, the Lord has chosen you for his inheritance, alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui beátum Marcum Evangelístam tuum evangélicæ prædicatiónis grátia sublimásti: tríbue, quǽsumus; eius nos semper et eruditióne profícere et oratióne deféndi.
text.en: O God, Who didst exalt thy blessed Evangelist Mark, by giving him grace to preach thine Evangel, grant unto us, we beseech thee, ever to follow more and more what he teacheth, and ever to be shielded from all evil by his prayers.
